observation_source: Separate local Mac Codex helper, verified Darwin ARM64 task, executing the publicly obtained release in an already available Mac-hosted Colima Linux ARM64 container. Root revalidated returned JSON bundles and matching SQLite snapshots without executing archived helper code.
limitations: External-host agent workflow evidence, not human scientific or accessibility review.
Linux ARM64 / Python 3.12.13 / SQLite 3.46.1 differ from the original x86_64 / Python 3.12.14 / SQLite 3.53.1 environment. Native macOS support and external x86_64 parity are not established.
The 19 commands cover the packaged workflow; they do not assert that the full 53-test suite ran on ARM64.

The fresh MATCH reproduction is of the Mac-generated bundle. A formal source-bound reproduction of the VPS campaign bundled in the release is requested separately; matching point-value traces do not erase runtime differences.
